title: Final curated-anchor direct facsimile audit
provenance_note: AI-assisted direct visual collation of all 60 curated seed anchors against the user-supplied Steffel 1809 facsimile. All 60 anchors coincide with genuine lexicographic article starts. Historical long-s, diacritics, OCR-damaged headwords and four page assignments are corrected. This closes facsimile boundary review for all 2,495 corpus candidates; independent human/philological and linguistic validation remains pending.
